keyword: order electric 50 concrete pump stone row

title.en: On Electric 50, the Xingtai Order Names One of Three Stone Rows
title.zh: 订电动50时，邢台的订单要点明三行石子中的一行

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 50 at 55 kW and 26 m³/h, then three distance rows: fine stone 150/350 m, 13 mm 80/240 m, 24 mm 60/180 m. The order names one row.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50印成 55 kW、26 m³/h，然后三行距离：细石 150/350 m、13 mm 80/240 m、24 mm 60/180 m。订单要点明一行。

h1.en: Pick One Electric 50 Stone Row for the Quote
h1.zh: 报价时选定电动50的一行石子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 50 with one output, 26 m³/h, and three conveying pairs. Fine stone is 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. 24 mm stone is 60 m / 180 m. The motor is 55 kW, pressure 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, frame 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm and weight 2800 kg. Your inquiry should say which stone label you are buying against. Diesel 50 also prints 30 MPa but at 30 m³/h on a diesel engine. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）给电动50印一个输送量 26 m³/h 和三组距离。细石是 150 m / 350 m。13 mm 石子是 80 m / 240 m。24 mm 石子是 60 m / 180 m。电机 55 kW，压力 30 MPa，料斗 0.4 m³，外形 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm，重量 2800 kg。询盘应写明你对照的石子标题。柴油50也印 30 MPa，但是柴油机上的 30 m³/h。没有印价格。

body.en: 150 m and 60 m are not a 105 m catalogue distance. They are alternative labels.
body.zh: 150 m 和 60 m 不是目录上的 105 m。它们是备选标题。

body.en: Weight match is not a path match. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW.
body.zh: 重量相同不是路径相同。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW。

body.en: Send the stone label with [/en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/) to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 把石子标题和 [/zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/) 发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

answer.en: Xingtai, after the row is named.
